# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Parent: cand_0001 (champion, val 0.360). cand_0002 (locate-by-route via a NEW `list_user_reservations` tool + locate prose + insurance clarification) moved val to 0.430 but was REJECTED as insignificant (Δ+0.070, fixed={}, broke={}) and its whole batch reverted. Root lesson from that RESULT: the gain was flaky, not a locked-in flip, and a NEW tool only helps if the mid-tier reader CHOOSES to call it. This iteration re-attacks the same clusters but (a) moves the disambiguating info into `get_user_details` — the call the agent ALWAYS makes — so it arrives unavoidably, and (b) ships a LARGER batch (4 code + 5 prose levers across 5 clusters) to clear the significance bar.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrong-reservation selection | 17, 22 (also aids 8, 19) | agent acts on the FIRST reservation in the bare id list instead of the one matching the user's route/city ("New York→Chicago", "trip to Texas"); it never sees city names, only opaque ids | CAPABILITY-GAP | enrich `get_user_details` to always return per-reservation route/city summaries (code) + locate-by-route prose |
| 2 | Refund/charge amount not communicated | 11 | agent gets the DB right but never states the exact refund figure ("5244"); COMMUNICATE check fails even when db_match=True (verified: t7 db_match=True, comm=False) | KNOWLEDGE→CODE | surface exact `payment_summary` amount in the update tools' return (code) + prose to always state it |
| 3 | Over-action beyond request / budget | 12 | agent upgrades cabin to business ignoring the user's stated $650 cap; full upgrade ($1200>650) and per-passenger upgrade are both impossible, so gold does NO cabin change (bags only) | BEHAVIORAL | budget-cap + per-reservation-cabin prose |
| 4 | Transfers instead of acting | 19 (also 37) | agent transfers a cancellable reservation, mis-adjudicating insurance ("feeling unwell" IS a health reason, covered) | BEHAVIORAL | insurance health/weather prose + "act before transferring" prose |
| 5 | Preserved from cand_0001 | 37, dob, payment | (already-guarded clusters — kept untouched) | — | none (preserve) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body enrichment (READ) | tools.py `get_user_details` + `_IATA_TO_CITY`/`_city_label`/`_reservation_summary` | now returns `user.model_dump()` PLUS `reservations_details`: each reservation's origin/destination as `IATA (City)`, cabin, flight_type, status, dates, flight numbers, passengers, insurance. The agent can match a trip by city and act on the right id instead of guessing. | Yes — it's a READ (never mutates the graded DB; verified DB hash unchanged); ALL raw user fields are still present; verified 0 errors across all 500 users; JSON-serializable. |
| 2 | return-value surfacing | tools.py `update_reservation_flights`, `update_reservation_baggages` + `_with_payment_summary` | return now wraps `reservation.model_dump()` with a `payment_summary` {amount_charged_to_user, amount_refunded_to_user, direction, payment_id, ready-to-say note}. | Yes — RETURN-VALUE only; the reservation is already mutated in place BEFORE the return, so db_match is identical to cand_0001 (verified: task 11 → refund 5244; task 12 → $0). Adding info cannot remove info a passing COMMUNICATE check needs. |
| 1 | prose | policy.md new "## Locating a reservation" + strengthened Modify/Cancel locate lines | get user id → `get_user_details` → pick the reservation whose cities/dates match → act only on it; never guess / never act on the first-listed; EWR/JFK/LGA=New York, IAH=Houston(TX), DFW=Dallas(TX). | Additive; a task that already has an id is unaffected. |
| 2 | prose | policy.md Modify→Payment | after a change, read `payment_summary` and always tell the user the exact dollar figure; do not round/omit. | Additive; reinforces the surfaced field. |
| 3 | prose | policy.md Change cabin | cabin applies to ALL passengers together (cannot upgrade only some); if a stated max is exceeded by the change cost, do NOT perform it; a separate free-bag request is still carried out. | Bounded — fires only when cost>stated max or a partial-upgrade is asked; no-budget tasks unaffected. |
| 4 | prose | policy.md Cancel insurance bullet + transfer paragraph | health (feeling unwell/ill/injured) and weather reasons ARE insurance-covered → proceed with the cancel; before transferring, confirm the action is truly out of scope, else perform it. | Additive; change-of-plan is still uncovered, so no passing refuse-task flips; transfer rule is a restatement (in-scope actions were never meant to transfer). |

## Verify-the-fix (trace targeted → what happens now on those exact inputs)
- get_user_details / cluster 1: omar_rossi_1241 (tasks 17/22) → `reservations_details` shows FQ8APE is the ONLY `EWR (Newark) → ORD (Chicago)` reservation (the "New York to Chicago" gold); the other three go elsewhere, so the agent can stop grabbing UM3OG5 (Seattle→Dallas, first in list). olivia_gonzalez_2305 (task 19) → Z7GOZK is the only `EWR (Newark) → IAH (Houston)` = the "Texas trip", ins=yes. Verified 500/500 users return without error; DB hash unchanged by the read.
- update_reservation_flights / cluster 2: GV1N64 business→basic_economy (task 11) → `payment_summary.amount_refunded_to_user = 5244`, note "a refund of $5244 will be issued to gift_card_1642017"; cabin mutated to basic_economy in the DB exactly as before. This directly targets t7 (db_match=True but comm=False on '5244').
- update_reservation_baggages / cluster 2+3: YAX4DR (gold econ, 2 pax) add 2 bags → nonfree recomputed 0, `payment_summary` "no additional charge or refund", cabin stays economy, no payment appended; DB mutated (total_baggages=2, nonfree=0) as before. The Change-cabin prose now blocks the wrong business upgrade the failing trials made.
- cancel_reservation (preserved from cand_0001): re-verified Z7GOZK ALLOWED (insurance), IFOYYZ BLOCKED (no condition) — unchanged.
- Syntax + import: `ast.parse` OK; module imports cleanly under the tau2 venv.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / parallel: used 3 diagnosis subagents earlier in the run to cluster failures; edits + verification done serially against the real airline DB via the tau2 venv (2-file edit space; parallel writes would add no signal).
- Prior iterations read (RUNMAP + prior_iterations/ + JOURNAL + LEDGER): cand_0001 (ACCEPT, +0.130) and cand_0002 (REJECT, +0.070, batch reverted). Reused cand_0002's `_IATA_TO_CITY`/`_city_label` code and locate/insurance prose, but redirected the disambiguation into `get_user_details` (always called) instead of a separate opt-in tool — the specific weakness its RESULT implied.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- ALL of cand_0001's code kept intact: payment/passenger dict normalization, single-payment amount auto-fill, nonfree_baggages recompute, 2-layer cancel eligibility guard, enriched errors.
- Enriched `get_user_details` returning `reservations_details` — the unavoidable route/city disambiguation (route it through the always-called tool, not a separate one).
- `payment_summary` surfacing on the update tools — return-value only, grading-safe, targets COMMUNICATE checks.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- A separate `list_user_reservations` tool (cand_0002): reverted for insignificance and depends on the agent choosing to call it. Superseded by enriching `get_user_details`.
- cand_0002's "change-of-plan NOT covered" wording was KEPT (accurate) — but note task 19's canonical reason is health ("feel unwell"), so the health-covered clarification is what matters there; verified against the task definition.
- Task 23 (payment-split ordering) and task 25 (passenger-dob from existing reservation): left for a successor; no safe code lever found that doesn't risk write-regression on split allocation.
- Multi-payment split auto-allocation: still NOT attempted (regression risk flagged since cand_0001).
